I’ll check the shared Gemini and Vertex AI request conversion, add tool-choice handling, and cover it with focused tests. I’m using the repository’s Python style skill.
Both providers use the same request adapter for regular and streaming chat. I’ll add the mapping there: `required` to `ANY`, `none` to `NONE`, and a named function to `ANY` with that function as the only allowed name. Omitted and automatic choices will keep the existing behavior.
The change and regression tests are in place, covering both providers, both request modes, all tool choices, and requests with no tools. The test run stopped during collection because the default Python is 3.9, which cannot parse existing repository code. I’ll check for an installed compatible interpreter without installing anything.
Updated the shared Gemini/Vertex AI adapter to honor `required`, `none`, and named-function choices for regular and streaming requests. Automatic and omitted choices retain existing behavior; requests without tools send no tool configuration.

Added 60 regression cases. `git diff --check` passed. Tests could not run: Python 3.9 cannot parse existing code, and installed newer interpreters lack pytest. No dependencies were installed.

+def _ragged_array(rows):
+    # np.array() can't build an object array of uneven-length arrays directly.
+    arr = np.empty(len(rows), dtype=object)
+    arr[:] = [np.array(row) for row in rows]
+    return arr
+

     with pytest.raises(MlflowException, match="2-dimensional"):
         dataset.to_evaluation_dataset()
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("rows_a", "rows_b"),
+    [
+        ([[{"a": 1}, {"a": 2}], [{"a": 3}]], [[{"a": 1}], [{"a": 2}, {"a": 3}]]),
+        ([[1, 2], [3]], [[1], [2, 3]]),

+)
+def test_hash_array_like_obj_as_bytes_with_ragged_nested_arrays(rows_a, rows_b):
+    hash_a = _hash_array_like_obj_as_bytes(_ragged_array(rows_a))
+

+    assert hash_a != _hash_array_like_obj_as_bytes(_ragged_array(rows_b))

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("missing_idx", [0, 1])

+    missing, missing_idx

+    data[missing_idx] = missing

+    assert _hash_array_like_obj_as_bytes(data) == _hash_array_like_obj_as_bytes(data.copy())

+def test_from_numpy_with_ragged_nested_targets():

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("provider_name", ["gemini", "vertex_ai"])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("stream", [False, True])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("tool_names", [None, [], ["get_weather", "get_time"]])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("tool_choice", "expected_config"),
+    [
+        (None, None),
+        ("auto", None),
+        ("required", {"mode": "ANY"}),
+        ("none", {"mode": "NONE"}),
+        (
+            {"type": "function", "function": {"name": "get_time"}},
+            {"mode": "ANY", "allowedFunctionNames": ["get_time"]},
+        ),
+    ],
+)
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+async def test_chat_tool_choice(provider_name, stream, tool_names, tool_choice, expected_config):
+    config = chat_config()
+    if provider_name == "vertex_ai":
+        config["model"].update(
+            provider="vertex_ai",
+            config={"vertex_project": "test-project", "vertex_location": "us-central1"},
+        )
+        provider = VertexAIProvider(EndpointConfig(**config))
+        provider._cached_credentials = mock.Mock(token="test-token", valid=True)
+    else:
+        provider = GeminiProvider(EndpointConfig(**config))
+
+    payload = {"messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Hello"}]}
+    if tool_names is not None:
+        payload["tools"] = [
+            {
+                "type": "function",
+                "function": {
+                    "name": name,
+                    "description": name,
+                    "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": {}},
+                },
+            }
+            for name in tool_names
+        ]
+    if tool_choice is not None:
+        payload["tool_choice"] = tool_choice
+
+    response = {
+        "candidates": [{"content": {"parts": [{"text": "Hello"}]}, "finishReason": "STOP"}]
+    }
+    mock_response = (
+        MockAsyncStreamingResponse([f"data: {json.dumps(response)}\n\n".encode()])
+        if stream
+        else MockAsyncResponse(response)
+    )
+    mock_client = mock_http_client(mock_response)
+    with mock.patch("aiohttp.ClientSession", return_value=mock_client) as mock_build_client:
+        request = chat.RequestPayload(**payload)
+        if stream:
+            assert [chunk async for chunk in provider.chat_stream(request)]
+        else:
+            await provider.chat(request)
+
+    mock_build_client.assert_called_once()
+    mock_client.post.assert_called_once()
+    body = mock_client.post.call_args.kwargs["json"]
+    if tool_names and expected_config:
+        assert body["toolConfig"] == {"functionCallingConfig": expected_config}
+    else:
+        assert "toolConfig" not in body
+    if tool_names:
+        assert [tool["name"] for tool in body["tools"][0]["functionDeclarations"]] == tool_names
+    else:
+        assert "tools" not in body
+
+
